name: Vampire - Move - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a legendary

results.text: The vampire's cloak billows as it readies to move with unholy grace.
Fangs glint in the moonlight as the undead monster prepares its legendary stride.
A chilling whisper echoes as the vampire gathers itself to strike unseen.
Shadows coil around its feet, anticipating the creature's swift, silent motion.
The air grows cold as the vampire's eyes gleam with predatory intent.
